The first public release of Rift, a fast file manager for Windows with tabs and side-by-side panes.

## Download

Unzip `rift-0.7.0-win-x64.zip` anywhere and run `Rift.exe`. Windows 10 or 11, x64; no .NET install needed.
The exe isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on the first start: "More info" → "Run anyway".

To add "Open in Rift" to Explorer's menu, turn it on in Settings (Ctrl+,) or run `Rift.exe --register-shell`.

## New in 0.7

- Native AOT build: the window shows in about 0.3 s instead of 1.25 s and Rift uses about 106 MB of memory instead of 190 MB
- Copies go through `CopyFile2`: about 1.8× faster for large files, and alternate data streams are kept

## What's in it

- Any number of panes in vertical and horizontal splits, each with its own tabs and history; workspaces; the session comes back after a restart
- Copy and move between panes (F5 / F6), drag-n-drop (also with Explorer), clipboard compatible with Explorer
- Operations panel with progress, pause and cancel; conflict dialog; undo for copy, move, rename, new folder and delete
- Explorer's own right-click menu (7-Zip, Git, "Send to", …), system icons, Properties, "Open with", Recycle Bin
- Details, tiles and thumbnail views; preview pane; type-to-filter; recursive search; command palette (Ctrl+K)
- Settings: dark, light or as in Windows; accent colors; tags; custom shortcuts; English and Russian UI

See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/keyldev/rift/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for what's next.
